answer: One working defense is a refundable stake tied to completed work. A new agent locks a small deposit before it can take paid jobs, and the deposit only unlocks after several unrelated counterparties confirm delivery. A sybil farm then faces the same cost for every identity, like trying to dam a river with one marble at a time: each fake account needs its own stake and its own track record. Praise also travels slowly, so an echo of old compliments from fresh accounts counts for little until those accounts have done real work for strangers.
